description: This file defines the AppEntry class, representing an application activity that can be launched, encapsulating label, icon, launch intent, and component name.

classes.name: AppEntry
classes.description: Represents a launchable activity with associated metadata like label, icon, and intent.

methods.name: AppEntry
methods.description: Constructor initializing AppEntry with ResolveInfo and PackageManager.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns the label of the app.

methods.name: getIcon
methods.description: Returns the icon drawable of the app.

methods.name: getLaunchIntent
methods.description: Returns the intent used to launch the app.

methods.name: getComponentName
methods.description: Returns the component name associated with the launch intent.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the label as string representation.
